name: Other other complaints
definition: other complaints that fit none of the specific other issues (General praise or general criticism with no specific feature, unrelated content, politics/boycott slogans, or no supported specific topic.)

name: Excessive Ad Interruptions
definition: Complaints that ads are too frequent, long, loud, or interrupt listening, including ads appearing before or between songs.

name: Other billing complaints
definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

name: Free-Tier Song Choice and Ordering
definition: Free users are forced into shuffle or cannot choose specific songs, play tracks in order, or use a queue.

name: Wrong Songs or Playback Controls
definition: Playback ignores the selected song or user controls, such as playing different tracks or failing to skip or shuffle as requested.

name: Free-Tier Playback Controls Restricted
definition: Free users face limits on skipping, replaying, or seeking within songs, or cannot repeat tracks.

name: Restricted Playback Controls
definition: Complaints that users cannot reliably choose and play specific songs or control playback with options such as skip, seek, repeat, or playing tracks in order.

name: Update Removes Basic Features
definition: Include complaints that recent app updates remove familiar features or make music streaming and basic listening worse.

name: App Crashes or Won't Load
definition: The app crashes, shuts down, or gets stuck on a launch or loading screen, preventing playback or continued use.

name: False or Failed Network Connection
definition: The app reports no connection or fails to access playback despite working internet, including when using particular network types.

name: Other downloads complaints
definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

name: Other playback complaints
definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

name: Other usability complaints
definition: usability complaints that fit none of the specific usability issues (Navigation, controls, layout, UI changes, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions (e.g. 'new home screen is confusing', 'too many ads between songs').)

name: Playback Stops Unexpectedly
definition: Music or podcasts pause or stop mid-playback without user input, sometimes failing to resume correctly.

name: Premium Subscription Purchase or Access Fails
definition: Users cannot complete a Premium purchase or sign-up, or a paid subscription does not unlock access.

name: Missing or Removed Catalog Content
definition: Songs, artists, or genres customers want are unavailable, missing from the catalog, or removed.

name: Confusing Home Screen Navigation
definition: Complaints that app layout or home-screen changes make it harder to find playlists, mixes, recently played items, or other content.

name: Lyrics Missing or Failing to Load
definition: Lyrics are unavailable for songs or fail to display or load in the Android app.

name: Unwanted or Repetitive Recommendations
definition: Recommendations or DJ selections are irrelevant, repetitive, or continue appearing when customers do not want them or have disabled them.

name: Login errors and connection detection
definition: Users cannot sign in because the app reports an error or falsely indicates there is no internet connection.

name: Playback Device Connection Fails
definition: The app cannot reliably connect to or cast playback to another device, such as a smart speaker, console, or computer.

name: Excessive Listening Restrictions
definition: Include complaints that limits or premium changes restrict basic music listening or make the service feel overly costly.

name: Missing Playlist Management Tools
definition: Complaints about missing or broken tools for searching, viewing, organizing, or queuing tracks in playlists and liked songs.

name: Phone number sign-in failures
definition: Users cannot access their account because phone-number verification or sign-in rejects their number or repeatedly demands a new one.

name: Basic Features Moved Behind Premium
definition: Features beyond song selection and playback controls, such as lyrics or higher audio quality, are restricted to Premium.

name: Hacked account recovery
definition: Users report an account takeover and difficulty recovering access or account content.

name: Password rejected
definition: The app refuses a password during account sign-in.

name: Account access blocked
definition: Users are prevented from entering their account without a more specific password, phone-number, or connection cause being identified.

name: Other access complaints
definition: access complaints that fit none of the specific access issues (Login, signup, password or account access problems (e.g. 'can't log in', 'account hacked', 'logged out every day').)

name: App Bugs and Unwanted Startup
definition: Include reports of technical problems or confusing behavior, such as the app starting despite permissions being disabled.

name: Other catalog complaints
definition: catalog complaints that fit none of the specific catalog issues (Missing songs or artists, removed content, search and discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability, podcasts content.)
